text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Dants... Did you get roped into 
doing all sorts of favors for people 
again? You're as much of a pushover as 
ever."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... But everyone was in a pinch, and 
I had free time anyway, so it's no trouble 
at all~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks for worrying about me! From 
now on, I'll be careful not to get so 
easily pushed around.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, for now, give me half of 
those requests.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Th-That's really asking for too 
much, I'd feel bad.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's split the work. I've got 
free time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is the job I was entrusted 
with, so—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who the hell do you think you are? 
You saying I can't help out, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Pokke-chan, you're 
reliable, and I really look up to you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, works for me! No problem at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah! I'll do my b... Huh?? Wait, what??
